fullContent:
Balaguluchyadi Thailam (Oil) 
 Reference: Sahasrayogam – Tailayoga Prakarana – 14 
 Introduction 
 Balaguluchyadi Thailam is an Ayurvedic oil for the external application. In body it balances the vata and pitta doshas. It is used in Ayurvedic treatment of gout and arthritis. 
 Ingredients 
 256 g of coarse powder of each of:- 
 
 Bala – Sida cordifolia 
 Guduchi – Tinospora cordifolia 
 Surapadapa – Cedrus deodara 
 Water for decoction – 12.288 liters, boiled and reduced to 3.072 liters 
 
 Paste prepared from fine powders of 16 g of each of:- 
 
 Jatamansi – Nardostachys jatamansi 
 Amaya – Saussurea lappa 
 Chandana – Red Sandalwood – Pterocarpus santalinus 
 Kunduru – Boswellia serrata 
 Nata – Valeriana wallichi 
 Ashwagandha – Withania somnifera 
 Sarala – Pinus roxburghi 
 Rasna – Pluchea lanceolata 
 Taila – Oil of Sesamum indicum – 768 ml 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 All ingredients are added to til oil and oil is cooked with the oil paak method. 
 How to Use? 
 It is used for external application. 
 Indications 
 
 Gout 
 Arthritis   
 Catarrh 
 
 Side Effects 
 
 There are no recorded side effects of this medicine for external application. 
 Keep out of sight and reach of children. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
